title: Keyboard-driven panel resize & column reorder with RTL-localized affordances
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Dashboard and cost explorer users re-order and resize columns/panels with mouse interactions today, but keyboard-only users, screen reader users, and users on RTL locales lack a robust, discoverable, and localizable keyboard affordance. Resizing also lacks clear live region announcements and localized helper text. This ticket designs a keyboard-first interaction pattern for: 1) resizing columns/panels; 2) reordering columns/panels; 3) mirrored RTL behavior; and 4) localized affordance strings and motion-reduction considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard-only: Users can focus a panel or column handle and invoke a 'resize mode' via Enter or Space. While in resize mode, Arrow Left/Right (LTR) or Arrow Right/Left (RTL) adjusts size in 8px steps. Escape cancels and Enter confirms.
Reorder mode: Pressing 'R' while focused on a column handle enters reorder mode; Arrow keys move position; a live region announces 'Moved column X to position Y' in the page language.
RTL parity: All keyboard shortcuts and arrow mappings mirror correctly for RTL locales. Visual affordances (icon direction, tooltip copy) are localized and mirrored.

Screen reader announcements: Starting/resizing/confirming/canceling produce concise announcements (start: 'Resize started for column Name', during: 'Column Name width 320 pixels', confirm: 'Resize saved', cancel: 'Resize canceled'). Strings are provided for translation and include variable placeholders.
High contrast: Resize handles meet 4.5:1 contrast with surrounding surfaces and have >3px focus ring in high-contrast mode.

Prefers-reduced-motion: When reduce motion is enabled, resize and reorder animations are disabled and only immediate reflow occurs; announce timing avoids rapid-fire live region updates (throttled to 250ms).
Automated e2e tests cover: keyboard entry/exit of modes, RTL mappings, live region announcements, and persisted sizes across page refresh for a single session.
Design tokens: Provide mapping for focus token, handle color, tooltip background and localized tooltip copy. Token names must align with console token nomenclature.
accessibility_notes: Use role='separator' for visual handles but do not rely on default semantics; implement aria-label and aria-valuenow for width in px.
Live region: aria-atomic='true' and aria-live='polite' for start/confirm/cancel; aria-live='assertive' for errors only.
Avoid complex announcement floods: throttle updates (max 4 Hz) and provide final confirmation when user stops interacting for >300ms.

Localization: Provide full sentence templates and separate tokens for variable insertion. Example: '{action} started for {columnName}' where action translations may have prefixes/suffixes in some languages.

Keyboard discoverability: Add a visually hidden help trigger on focus with text 'Press Enter to resize, R to reorder, ? for shortcuts' that is localized and announced by SRs on focus for first-time users in a session.
Contrast: Focus ring and handle icons to be tested with WCAG color-blind simulations and in the console high-contrast theme.
Edge cases: For extremely narrow columns (<80px) provide a min-width and announce 'Minimum width reached' when user attempts to reduce further.
review_comments: 2025-01-12 | Priya Nair (UX Research): Ran 6 moderated sessions with screen reader users. Finding: The two-mode approach (resize vs reorder) is discoverable when a short toast appears first-time. Recommend adding an optional 'Don't show again' local storage flag.

2025-01-14 | Omar Alvi (Engineering): Feasibility: keyboard handlers map well to existing grid primitives. Concern: persistent sizes must be scoped to user/session to avoid layout drift across teams. Propose sessionStorage first, then settings opt-in.

2025-01-16 | Lina Ahmad (Localization PM): Note: Several languages require reordering of tokens; ensure placeholders include contextual markers for RTL token wrapping. We'll provide translation notes for all strings in the attached doc.

2025-01-18 | Accessibility Review (external): Recommend live region text avoid punctuation that causes extra pauses in some TTS engines. Also prefer 'Column {name} width {px}.' rather than 'Column {name}: width is {px}'.

2025-01-20 | Rafael Ortiz (Assignee): Implemented prototype updates: added 'resize-mode' cookie for first-time helper, throttled aria updates, mirrored arrow behavior for RTL. Pushed PR with updated token names. See related PRs.
2025-01-21 | Design Lead (Marisol Vega): Approve visual comps with minor color adjustments. Ask SRE to validate performance impact of throttled live updates.
decisions: Adopt two explicit modes (resize, reorder) to reduce accidental reflows and make keyboard interactions predictable.
Use Enter/Space to enter resize mode; use 'R' to enter reorder mode. Escape cancels both. These keys chosen to minimize conflicts with other app shortcuts.
Persist sizes to sessionStorage by default; add 'remember layout' toggle in user settings for cross-session persistence (follow-up PM ticket).
Provide translatable templates and a localization notes doc to ensure pluralization and RTL wrapping are handled by translators.

Engineering to implement keyboard handlers + live region per accessibility notes. Branch: feat/keyboard-resize. Owner: Omar. ETA: 2025-02-05.
QA to write e2e tests for keyboard resize/reorder and RTL mappings. Owner: QA team. Test plan in QA doc link in Drive.
Design to create a short first-time tooltip animation (reduce-motion aware) and provide assets. Owner: Rafael. ETA: 2025-01-24.
Follow-up PM ticket to capture persistent layout opt-in and analytics events (track 'resize_start', 'resize_confirm', 'reorder_complete').
audit_findings: A11Y-Audit-2025-01: Prior implementation had no focusable handle and relied on pointerdown events making keyboard users unable to start resize.
I18N-Audit-2025-01: Tooltip copy inserted inline icons that break RTL mirroring; updated components must separate icon and text and use flex-direction row-reverse in RTL.
